definition: a person who guards people or property
description: A sunny cafe terrace high above the sea. A young waitress with a dark ponytail, a white shirt and a black apron stands on a wicker chair and swings a white paper parasol at a monkey leaping towards the table, then holds the open parasol out like a shield. She is protecting a cake under a glass dome and cups of coffee from several more monkeys on the table and the railing. A cat hides under the table, a tourist crouches with a camera, and big white clouds rise over the coast.

taps.phrase: to stand on a wicker chair
to take shelter under the table
